set.rappels: Most parties walk off: an exposed 4th-class traverse west from the East Shoulder into the East Face descent gully. Rappelling the route is the alternative, on two 70 m ropes from a bolted station 20-30 ft above the old pitch-6 slung block to the bolted anchor atop pitch 5, then down the route on bolt and tree anchors; no count of rappels is published.
